blocking_methods.label: tollFree
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 1800-1080 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.

blocking_methods.instructions: Call +91-22-3366-7777 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.

Log in to internet banking at https://www.icicibank.com and use the card block/hotlist option.
